1613. C Selection Sort

40

Medium

Problem Statement:
Write a C program to implement Selection Sort on an array of integers. The program should read the size of the array and the elements from the user, sort the array in ascending order using the Selection Sort algorithm, and print the sorted array.

Requirements:

Input should be taken from the user.

Sorting must be done using Selection Sort only.

Display the sorted array as output.
